main_text.p: Interpretum & Hieronymi recentioribus Interpretibus ita oppofuerit, ut ab illis vel tantillum difcedere nefas fuerit. Hæc & alia bene multa ejufdem rationis in illo Capite, quod ex critica fua expunctum fuit, adverfus Morini fententiam Capellus animadverterat, quæ manifeste oftendunt, illum cum Morino nullatenus confensisse in evertend.[?] textus Hebræi autoritate, eiqve fubftituenda Græca Septuaginta Interpretum & Latina Hieronymi translatione; fi autem Capellum cum Morino comparare liceat in iis, quæ uterque de rebus Biblicis composuit, in hujus quidem libris plus eruditionis apparet, fed quæ fæpius sit extra rem; at in illo plus Ingenii atque Judicii qui nunquam à fcopo aberret, & id quod fibi propofuit, firmiffimis rationibus comprobet.

page.notes: Running head and page number are printed as shown. Catchword "nefi." is at the lower right and is kept out of the text. "evertend.[?]": a mark follows "evertend." that I could not read with certainty. "Hieronymi": a dot-like speck sits between "Hi" and "ronymi" and is treated as a printing artefact. The "qv" ligatures are rendered as "qu" (quod, qui, quae, uterque), per the u/v rule. Small capitals in "NON" are given as printed. The hyphen after "be" is printed, and the word continues on the next page.
